concepts.name: Three Modes of Losing Indian Citizenship
key_dimensions: Renunciation (voluntary surrender) - Section 8
Termination (acquisition of foreign citizenship) - Section 9
Deprivation (compulsory termination by Government) - Section 10

concepts.name: Deprivation of Citizenship: Grounds under Section 10
key_dimensions: Citizenship obtained by fraud, false representation or concealment
Disloyalty to the Constitution of India
Unlawful trading or communication with enemy during war
Imprisonment for 2+ years within 5 years of registration/naturalization
Ordinary residence outside India for 7 continuous years (for registered/naturalized citizens)

concepts.name: Deprivation: Distinction between Citizens by Birth vs Registration/Naturalization
key_dimensions: Citizens by birth cannot be deprived except on grounds of fraud or disloyalty
Registered/naturalized citizens subject to additional grounds (imprisonment, residence abroad)
Constitutional safeguard: No deprivation of citizenship by birth arbitrarily
UPSC trap: Specific grounds applicable only to naturalized citizens

concepts.name: Procedural Safeguards in Deprivation Cases
key_dimensions: Section 10(2): Inquiry by prescribed authority before deprivation

concepts.name: Effect of Termination on Minor Children
